The aim of this study is to identify germline mutations in individuals with breast cancer, such as BRCA and other genes. Results This analysis allowed the identification of variants associated with breast cancer in 307 patients from a population in southwestern Colombia, of which 19% had pathogenic and probably pathogenic mutations associated with hereditary cancer.
